summary: Reproduced at 0460dda4e410. Loading a 1001-element BF16 tensor to cuda:0 through SafetensorsCollection's deferred path (allow_bf16 false) produced an FP16 tensor whose only wrong element was the last one (index 1000: loaded -1.9004, expected -1.2031); a 1000-element tensor loaded through the same path matched torch's float16 conversion exactly.
what_ran: repro.py saves BF16 tensors of 1001 and 1000 elements, then loads both with exllamav3.loader.safetensors.SafetensorsCollection to cuda:0 between begin_deferred_load() and end_deferred_load() on physical GPU 1 (2 deferred tensors), and compares bit patterns with tensor.to(float16).
limits: One odd size; the one-element-final-chunk zero-block case was not constructed separately.
